description:
**Rescoped 2026-05-11 after code-state audit.**

Original framing (implement policies::code_signing + time_stamping + ocsp_responder as VerificationPolicy objects) is moot: the architecture is `Profile` → `ValidationPolicy` → `verify_chain`, not a policy stack. `CodeSigningProfile` already exists in `pkix-profiles-cabf` at `pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs:310` setting `required_leaf_eku = Some(vec![ID_KP_CODE_SIGNING])`.

What remains: **ship thin ergonomic wrappers `verify_code_signer`, `verify_time_stamper`, `verify_ocsp_responder` that compose existing profiles + `verify_chain`.** No identity binding needed for these (no caller-supplied hostname/mailbox).

Per-wrapper work:

- **`verify_code_signer(chain, anchors, time, revocation)`** — uses `CodeSigningProfile::policy(time)` + `verify_chain`. Profile already in `pkix-profiles-cabf`. May need a Basic version in `pkix-profiles` (RFC-baseline `id-kp-codeSigning` EKU only) per the framework-vs-policy split.

- **`verify_time_stamper(chain, anchors, time, revocation)`** — needs new `BasicTimeStampingProfile` setting `required_leaf_eku = Some(vec![ID_KP_TIME_STAMPING])`. RFC 3161 says timeStamping EKU MUST be critical and sole; profile sets a flag for `validate_path` to enforce critical-and-sole.

- **`verify_ocsp_responder(chain, anchors, issuer, time)`** — needs new `BasicOcspResponderProfile` setting `required_leaf_eku = Some(vec![ID_KP_OCSP_SIGNING])` + special delegation check: responder cert MUST be signed by the same `issuer` whose status it's asserting. May also need handling for the `id-pkix-ocsp-nocheck` extension (signals "do not check revocation on this responder cert"). The delegation check is the only non-trivial part.

**Blocks on:** `.7` (wrapper set + defaults decision determines which of these three actually ship in v0.x).
title: Implement verify_code_signer + verify_time_stamper + verify_ocsp_responder thin wrappers
